observations: Photo 0 shows three retail boxes for 'JBL CHARGE 6' in camouflage, sand, and black colors.
The boxes feature the JBL logo and 'CHARGE 6' branding prominently.
Packaging claims include 'Bluetooth v5.4', '20h' battery life, and an IP67 waterproof rating icon.
The image contains watermarks for 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'ULTRA PLUS'.
No actual speakers are shown outside of their packaging; only the boxes are visible.

claims.claim: Wireless connect up to 2 smartphones or tablets
claims.evidence: Requires physical testing or a video demonstration of two devices alternating playback.
JBL does not have a 'Charge 6' model in its official product lineup; the current series ends at Charge 5. This is a known counterfeit designation.

risks.proof: Manufacturer serial number verification or photo of the charging port area.
Photo of the actual speaker outside the box.
Video of the device powering on, pairing, and playing audio.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual speaker outside the box.
Video of the speaker powered on and playing music.
Photo of the serial number on the box or device.
response.reason: The model 'Charge 6' is a known counterfeit as it does not exist in the official JBL catalog. Because only boxes are shown, it is priced at the worst case of an empty box until the contents are proven.
